canonical_projection_note.fallback: The all-zero fallback is also transposed, so any fallback incidence is the image of an existing original-family incidence rather than new cover complexity.
canonical_projection_note.hybrid_switch_outside_scope: A one-time or nonuniform orientation schedule that transposes only selected levels is not globally tau(U_n) and is not ruled out by this theorem; it requires a separate language/reduction/gluing analysis.
canonical_projection_note.uniform_transpose: Canonical fresh transposed batches do not create a genuinely new interaction mechanism; the entire family is the row/column-swapped original family.

definitions.literal_transpose_family: Let T_2=U_2. For n>=3, T_n inherits T_(n-1) on old-old cells and adds (M+c,r) exactly when the same word Dec(bin_(n-1)(r)||bin_(n-1)(c)) is UNSAT; no other new complement cells are added.
definitions.original_family: Let U_n be the frozen C041 complement family. For level n with M=2^(n-1), U_n inherits U_(n-1) on old-old cells and adds (r,M+c) exactly when Dec(bin_(n-1)(r)||bin_(n-1)(c)) is UNSAT.

proof: The transposed complement selector reconstructs the identical decoded word x||y from old column x and fresh-row offset y.
Therefore the cell is complement exactly for UNSAT and graph exactly for SAT.
The NP witness remains an assignment accepted by the unchanged clause checker; only coordinate placement changes.
theorems.statement: The literal-transpose family preserves the C041 SAT/graph reduction exactly: if a canonical code is x||y with |x|=|y|=k, map it to the level k+1 query (2^k+int(y), int(x)); this cell is in the graph iff the unchanged decoder formula is SAT, with the same assignment witness.

proof: Base: the frozen seed U_2={(0,0),(2,1),(1,2),(2,2)} is invariant under tau.
Induction old-old: assuming T_(n-1)=tau(U_(n-1)), inherited cells map exactly under tau.
Induction cross block: tau sends each original old-new complement cell (r,M+c) selected by UNSAT Dec(bin(r)||bin(c)) to (M+c,r), exactly the literal-transpose selector.
Both families add no complement cells in the remaining new quadrants, so the cases are exhaustive.
The coordinate swap tau is a bijection of the ground set [N]x[N] and permutes the graph generator family by exchanging row and column generators.

It sends the complement U to tau(U), subsets E,H of U to tau(E),tau(H), and semi-filters F to {tau(S): S in F}. Upward closure, exclusion of the empty set, 'above w', and pair preservation are invariant under this bijection.
Hence the cover graphs in Definition 21 are isomorphic, preserving minimum pair-cover size rho.
The same generator permutation transports any union/intersection construction, so D and D_intersection are equal as well.
theorems.statement: For every n, rho(G_n^T,G_{2^n,2^n}) = rho(G_n,G_{2^n,2^n}); likewise intersection/discrete graph complexity is unchanged under tau.
